context.description: Context in which an observation, association, or change occurs; not interchangeable with a specialized domain role such as temperature_scope.

entity_a.description: First endpoint of a non-directional association.

entity_b.description: Second endpoint of a non-directional association.

mechanism.description: Mechanistic pathway or explanatory mechanism explicitly proposed or supported by the source.

mediator.description: Intermediate response, entity, or process through which a modal effect may occur.

response.description: Observed or discussed response whose qualitative strength is being characterized.

state.description: Qualitative state explicitly attributed or modally attributed to a subject.

subject.description: Entity, population, pool, system, or other subject whose state or trajectory is being described.

target_state.description: State, strategy, or condition toward which a subject shifts.

taxon.description: Taxonomic group at any explicitly stated rank; unlike species, this role does not imply species-level identity.

temporal_scope.description: Temporal scope over which variability or another comparison is described.
